title: Metric ownership workshop output and triage list
content:
Purpose
---
Notes from the 2025-11-03 observability workshop: we ran a focused 3-hour working session to map metric ownership, clarify metric definitions, and create a first-pass triage backlog for dashboard pruning and trace sampling. This doc is the raw output: actionable items, metric definitions we agreed to, and open questions to assign. Treat as a working artifact; expect follow-up edits.

High-level goals we set
- Reduce operator cognitive load by 30% via curated dashboards (fewer panels, clearer anchors).
- Ensure every SLI (critical) has a named owner and a defined alerting threshold.
- Standardize trace annotation for multi-hop token inference so session reconstruction is straightforward.

Quick outcomes (decisions made)
- Ownership model: primary owner + secondary reviewer for each metric group (runtime, batching/cache, model-quality, tenant-cost). Owners listed below.
- Naming convention accepted: <domain>.<entity>.<measure> (e.g., runtime.inference.latency_p95_ms). Use snake case for measure.
- Trace sampling policy: severity-weighted sampling for traces with errors and top-percentile latency traces 0.5% baseline + 100% for error spans.

Metric groups and owners (first pass)
- runtime.* — owner: Marisol Ortega, secondary: Leah Brooks
  - key SLIs: runtime.inference.latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, cpu_gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_hit_ratio
- batching_and_cache.* — owner: Devon Patel, secondary: Marisol Ortega
  - key signals: batch.size_median, batch.wait_time_p95_ms, cache_prefix_hit_rate, kv_cache_eviction_rate
- model_quality.* — owner: Samir Rao, secondary: Avery Chen
  - key signals: generation.hallucination_rate_daily, eval.promptset_regression_count, quality.score_median
- tenant_cost.* — owner: Leah Brooks, secondary: Devon Patel
  - key signals: tenant.token_cost_per_hour, tenant.request_rate_rps, tenant.cold_cache_fraction

Concrete metric definitions (drafts to copy into metric catalog)
- runtime.inference.latency_p95_ms = 95th percentile of end-to-end request latency measured at API ingress, measured over 5m sliding windows, unit: ms. Exclude streaming keepalives; include queued wait time.
- runtime.inference.latency_p50_ms = 50th percentile same window.
- runtime.inference.tail_outlier_count = count of requests in last 1h with latency > 3 * p95.
- batching.batch.size_median = median of batch sizes observed at runtime.{gpu_pool} aggregator: per-host and per-model.
- cache.kv_cache_hit_ratio = number of KV cache hits / (hits + misses) over 10m windows; tag by model_version.
- model.quality.hallucination_rate_daily = fraction of sampled outputs marked as hallucination by automated heuristic + manual review (hybrid method) per UTC day.

Tracing and annotation conventions (agreed primitives)
- span.name: prefer short names like "inference:token_gen" and include model shorthand in span.tag model:name.
- mandatory trace tags: trace.session_id, trace.request_id, tenant.id, model.name, model.version, stage (canary|prod|dedicated).
- span-level annotations for cache ops: cache.op_type = lookup|insert|evict, cache.key_type = prefix|kv, cache.hit = true|false.
- error tagging: span.tag error=true and error.type set to enum values (timeout, oom, model_mismatch, other).
- sampling: baseline reservoir 0.5% for all traces, plus rules: (a) error traces sampled at 100% for last 30d; (b) traces with latency > p99 sampled at 100% for 7d; (c) traces flagged by tenant in a debug flag sampled fully for 1h windows.

Dashboard pruning and UX notes
- Key dashboards to keep (operators-first):
  1) SLO health (per-deployment): p99/p95/p50 latency, error rate, token-per-second throughput, SLO burn rate.
  2) Billing-exposure per-tenant: rolling 24h cost, top-10 tenants by cost delta.
  3) Cold-cache investigations: cache-hit ratio over time + session reconstructions link.
  4) Model-quality quick-check: hallucination rate, eval fail count, recent manual-review queue length.
- Panel pruning rules: remove panels with >30% queries older than 90d; consolidate similar percentile panels into a small percentile strip (p50,p95,p99).
- Drilldown anchors: every high-level panel should include direct query links: link-to-trace (auto-populates session_id), link-to-exec-log, link-to-prompt-replay. Use the shortlink pattern /ops/investigate?session=<session_id>.

Triage backlog (prioritized)
1) OBS-412: Implement trace sampling rules in the collector (Devon) — blocker for debugging spikes (priority: P0).
2) Add metric definitions to metric-catalog page (Marisol, Samir) — include unit, aggregation window, tags (priority: P1).
3) Dashboard consolidation sprint: reduce panel count on SLO dashboard by 40% (Leah) — schedule: next sprint (P1).
4) Instrumentation gaps: add cache.eviction reasons and model.quantize_flag tags to spans (owner: Devon) (P2).
5) Create ownership roster doc and an oncall handoff checklist (Avery) (P2).
6) Build a synthetic probe for cold-cache patterns (owner: Marisol) — proof-of-concept by end of Q1 (P2).

Open questions / unresolved items
- How strict should metric deprecation be? We discussed soft-deprecation (mark deprecated for 60d then remove) vs hard-deprecation with migration paths. Action: Marisol to propose policy.
- Model-quality signal standardization: which automated heuristics count as "hallucination" vs human-review? Samir to draft the hybrid heuristic and examples.
- Tenant-scoped sampling: should we allow tenant-enabled full sampling without SRE approval? Need legal/CS input for PII risk. Assigned: Leah to coordinate with CS and security.

Quick ops play snippets (copyable)
- To find high-latency traces: query trace where runtime.inference.latency_ms > 3*runtime.inference.latency_p95_ms window=1h; group by model.version.
- To rebuild a session: open trace with tag trace.session_id -> expand spans -> use link-to-prompt-replay to fetch prompt and response.

Next steps and owners summary
- Implementation: Devon -> OBS-412 (collector changes), priority P0.
- Definitions/catalog: Marisol + Samir -> metric-catalog updates, deadline 2025-12-01.
- Dashboards: Leah -> consolidation sprint next cycle, checklist by 2025-11-20.
- Ownership doc + handoff: Avery -> draft by 2025-11-10 (then iterate).

Notes-to-self / workshop artifacts
- Raw whiteboard photos in Slack thread #obs-workshop-2025-11 (see pinned).
- Suggested follow-up session: 90-minute working meeting with CS + security to finalize tenant sampling policy.

Unstructured/brainstorm fragments (keep here)
- Could we add a telemetry-ownership pager rotation? maybe too noisy — prefer escalation to oncall when metric SLO enters critical state.
- Consider a "dashboard lite" view for execs with one-line SLO health and cost delta.
- Experiment: auto-annotate traces with recent rollout ids to correlate rollouts -> latency regressions.

If you have edits or want to claim ownership of an item, add a comment inline or ping me (Avery) in slack.
